fileLimit: UTF-8 .txt files · Up to 8 MiB each · Existing files are never replaced.
updateUnavailable: Update check unavailable. You can continue offline.
nativeUnavailable: The conversion engine could not be loaded. Reinstall the app package.
practiceNote: Up to 10 questions. Review mistakes in a separate round. Example call signs are for practice.
normalizationNote: Latin: Turkish letters are simplified. Russian: Ё → Е. Arabic: marks and tatweel are omitted; hamza carriers, ى and ة are normalized. Decoding cannot restore the original spelling.
question: Question
settingsRecovered: Preferences could not be read; defaults are in use.
unsupported: A character is not supported by the selected alphabet.
invalidMorse: Check the Morse code and word separator.
speechUnavailable: Speech is not available on this platform yet.
fileError: File conversion failed. Check UTF-8 encoding, the 8 MiB limit and an unused output name.
speechLimit: Speech is limited to 4000 characters at a time.
converterHint: Convert between text and Morse code.
speechLocalNote: Text is processed on this device. Stop also cancels speech.
arabicVoiceNote: Kareem: Jordanian Arabic, one speaker. Text stays on this device.
speechPackMissing: Offline speech pack missing. Select it in Settings → Speech pack.
speechPackHelp: Install the pack once; speech works without internet. Models load only during synthesis. If you moved the pack, select its folder.
speechError: Speech generation failed. Check the speech pack installation.
thanksBody: Thank you to the developers of the open-source models and tools that make offline speech possible.
creditsLicenseNote: Engines and voice models have separate licenses; each source retains its own license.
updateConfirm: Update verified. Confirm to open Setup. MorseCore will close; your files, settings and voice pack will be kept.
updateFailed: The update could not be downloaded or verified. Retry or download it from the release page.
glossaryHint: Short definitions, examples and Morse audio. Prosigns such as <AR> are sent without a gap between letters.
radioLocal: Call signs, CW preparation and local logs. This version does not connect to a radio or transmit RF.
selectClass: Select the class on your licence
callOfflineNote: Recognition uses format and prefix only; it does not verify assignment, ownership or licence validity. Check the class against your licence.
stationCheck: Check country, class and call sign together.
unknownCountry: Country not recognised in this catalog
rulesCoverage: Selected CW ranges; not a complete rule set or transmission authorisation. Upper edge excluded. Keep the whole signal inside the band; check licence, local conditions and band plan separately.
stationRequired: Save a station and select its licence class first.
bandMatch: Matches a listed reference range; read the conditions
bandUnlisted: Class/frequency not in the selected table. Transmission eligibility is unverified; check the official source.
rstHint: CW report: readability 1–5, strength 1–9, tone 1–9. Enter the report you actually observed.
qsoProcedureNote: Listen first, check the frequency and wait for a reply. Prepared text is a CW template; every message includes your call. No radio connection or automatic transmission.
logHint: Shows the latest 50 records; export includes all records of the selected type. Practice and real contacts are separate. ADIF contains basic ASCII contact fields; CSV preserves all notes.
radioDataError: Radio data could not be read. Existing files are preserved; back up and inspect before changing them.
fixedCallNote: Registered call; check location and licence.
portableCallNote: Suggested domestic suffix; verify licence conditions.
portableCallReview: Confirm and enter the full call under this country's operating rules.
visitorCallReview: Visitor privileges are not assumed. Enter the locally authorised class and confirmed full call.
manualCallReview: Full call confirmed by the user; authorisation and assignment not verified.
bandConditions: Reference only: source footnotes, licence and local conditions apply.
trHomebuilt: Class B: this HF exception requires home-built equipment of at most 5 W.
trRules: CW transmitter output limits are shown; do not confuse them with PEP values. Emergency priority and Table 25 footnotes apply. Area-change suffixes depend on notification requirements.
deRules: AFuV classes A/E/N are assessed separately. N uses ERP; other rows use the stated PEP limits. Check site, antenna and EMF conditions in the source.
ruRules: SRR's GKRCh references were reviewed; the current official power annex was inaccessible. Automatic frequency/power matching is disabled for this profile. Verify category and operating call against your licence.
gbRules: OFW611 Schedule 1 tables A/B/C. Ground stations only; airborne and coordination exceptions are excluded. Suffixes may be optional; check the regional letter rule for Intermediate calls starting with 2.
usRules: Selected CW ranges from 47 CFR 97, ITU Region 2 only. Region 1/3 and 60 m exceptions excluded. A call sign does not determine licence class; select it from the licence.
saRules: CST RR55 (2025), annexes 19-1 and 20. The reversed 80 m limits printed in the English document are omitted, not guessed. Class 2 shows only explicitly listed microwave ranges; your licensed frequencies govern.
aeRules: TDRA v3 annexes 1/2: B is limited to 144–146 MHz, 50 W PEP. A65 does not determine A/B class. Check individual authorisation and suffix conditions.
otherRules: No built-in rules for this country. Verify local permissions and call rules manually; the app does not infer transmission privileges.
term_qrl: Is the frequency in use? Listen and wait for a reply.
term_qrv: Ready; with a question mark, are you ready?
term_qsl: Receipt acknowledgement; contact confirmation by context.
term_cq: General call to any suitable station.
term_k: Invitation to transmit; any station may reply.
term_kn: Reply invited from the addressed station only.
term_rst: Readability, signal strength and tone for CW.
term_ar: End of message. A and R are sent as one sign.
term_sk: End of contact. S and K are sent as one sign.
term_as: Wait. A and S are sent as one sign.
term_knProsign: Over to the addressed station only; K and N joined.
term_hh: Error sign: eight dots; correct the mistaken part.
